cert.untrusted: Your computer does not trust the certificate of {0}
cert.untrustedDetail:
This is often a self-signed certificate or a private certificate authority on your own server. Only trust it if you are sure it belongs to your server – compare the fingerprint with the one on the server. Flowplan then trusts exactly this certificate for {0} in this profile, no other.

{1}

cert.unpinDetail:
Flowplan restarts for this. Afterwards the profile only opens when your system trusts the server's certificate – or you trust it again.

settings.title: Settings
settings.trayHint: Quick capture, today's tasks and unread notifications. On Windows and Linux, Flowplan then keeps running after its window is closed.
settings.captureHint: A shortcut opens a small window above every app: into the inbox, a database, today's journal entry or a page – with shorthand like #tag, @person, tomorrow 3pm, !high, with links, files, screen regions and voice notes, also offline.
settings.shortcutIsOff: Off – quick capture stays in the menu and the icon.
settings.shortcutTaken: {0} is already used by another app. Choose another combination.
settings.updateNotesHint: Whether “What’s new?” shows what changed when the app updates. Only breaking changes: only when something changes in a way you need to adapt to.
settings.queueWaiting: {0} capture(s) waiting for the connection, sent automatically.
settings.queueFailed: {0} capture(s) need your attention – view them in the capture window.
settings.queueEncrypted: The queue and “Recently captured” are stored on this computer, encrypted with the system's key store.
settings.queuePlain: No system key store available: the queue and “Recently captured” are stored unencrypted in the app's data folder, readable only by your user account.
settings.actionsHint: More shortcuts that open the capture window ready for one thing. None is active without a shortcut.
settings.actionNeedsSignIn: Targets appear once the active profile is signed in.
settings.deviceAi: Use Apple Intelligence on this Mac
settings.deviceAiHint: Optional. Flowplan's AI features can use Apple's model on this Mac – prompts and answers never leave the Mac. Switched off, Flowplan never starts the model and the instance gets no access to it (open pages after reloading). Needs macOS 26, a Mac with Apple silicon and Apple Intelligence switched on.
settings.deviceAiIsOff: Off – Flowplan does not use the model.
settings.deviceAi.unsupported-os: Not available – needs macOS 26 or newer.
settings.deviceAi.device-not-eligible: Not available – this Mac does not support Apple Intelligence.
settings.deviceAi.apple-intelligence-off: Apple Intelligence is off – switch it on in System Settings → Apple Intelligence & Siri.
settings.deviceAi.model-not-ready: The model is still downloading – please try again later.
settings.deviceAi.unsupported-language: Not available – this Mac's language is not supported yet.
ai.error.unavailable: Apple Intelligence is not available on this Mac.
ai.error.context-too-long: The text is too long for the model on this Mac.
ai.error.busy: The model is answering another request.
ai.error.error: The model on this Mac could not answer.
